conditions: 仅适用于日本外务省 Note 5 所限定的香港特区护照，或具有香港居留权的 BNO。
rules.evidenceLocator: Japan MOFA visa exemption list, Hong Kong row, Note 5
rules.evidenceExcerpt: For nationals of Hong Kong, visas are not required only for holders of SAR passports issued by the Hong Kong SAR of the PRC or British National Overseas passports who have the right of residence in Hong Kong.

conditions: 仅适用于日本外务省 Note 6 所限定的澳门特区护照。
rules.evidenceLocator: Japan MOFA visa exemption list, Macao row, Note 6
rules.evidenceExcerpt: For nationals of Macao, visas are not required only for holders of SAR passports issued by the Macao SAR of the PRC.

conditions: 中国普通护照不适用香港或澳门证件条目；签证类别与材料需转日本使领馆核验。
rules.evidenceLocator: Japan MOFA visa exemption list; China is not included in the ordinary-passport short-stay exemption table
rules.evidenceExcerpt: The exemption table lists Hong Kong and Macao only under their passport-specific notes; ordinary PRC passports are not included.

conditions: 香港管制站身份证明与进入内地所需证件必须分别检查。
rules.evidenceLocator: Hong Kong Immigration Department travel-document FAQ
rules.evidenceExcerpt: The official FAQ distinguishes Hong Kong identity documents from travel documents used for journeys outside Hong Kong.

conditions: 澳门居民身份证和通行证是基础组合；实际口岸、通道及自动通关登记仍需复核。
rules.evidenceLocator: Macao SAR Government PS-1474 eligibility and document requirements
rules.evidenceExcerpt: Macao resident identity documentation and the applicable mainland travel permit are handled as distinct documents; channel eligibility remains conditional.

conditions: 仅适用于香港居民使用香港特区护照。
出发前必须取得 NZeTA，并使用申请 NZeTA 时的同一本护照旅行。
最终入境许可由新西兰边境决定。
rules.evidenceLocator: Visa waiver countries and territories > Applicants from Hong Kong; Authority to travel; How long you can stay
rules.evidenceExcerpt: You can only travel visa waiver if you are a resident and travel on ... Hong Kong Special Administrative Region [passport]. You must have an NZeTA before you travel to New Zealand. You can stay for up to 3 months.

conditions: 仅适用于澳门居民使用澳门特区护照。
出发前必须取得 NZeTA，并使用申请 NZeTA 时的同一本护照旅行。
最终入境许可由新西兰边境决定。
rules.evidenceLocator: Visa waiver countries and territories > Applicants from Macau; Authority to travel; How long you can stay
rules.evidenceExcerpt: You can only travel visa waiver if you are a resident and travel on a Macau Special Administrative Region passport. You must have an NZeTA before you travel to New Zealand. You can stay for up to 3 months.

conditions: 中国普通护照不能仅按国籍直接判定。
只有从澳大利亚前往新西兰且持符合条件的澳大利亚签证时，才可能进入该页的签证豁免分支。
其他情况必须改查适用访客签证。
rules.evidenceLocator: Visa Waiver Visitor Visa overview and eligibility > Chinese visitors travelling from Australia
rules.evidenceExcerpt: To apply you must be travelling on a passport from a visa waiver country or territory, or travelling from Australia on a passport from China and with an eligible Australian visa.

conditions: 仅表示跨越申根成员国外部边境的短期旅游签证要求；居留许可、长期停留和特殊身份另行核验。
rules.evidenceLocator: Regulation (EU) 2018/1806, Article 3(1) and Annex I, PDF page 13
rules.evidenceExcerpt: Nationals of third countries listed in Annex I shall be required to be in possession of a visa when crossing the external borders of the Member States. Annex I lists China.

conditions: 任何连续 180 天内累计不超过 90 天。
豁免仅适用于香港特别行政区护照。
不等同于保证入境，仍须满足外部边境入境条件。
rules.evidenceLocator: Regulation (EU) 2018/1806, Article 4(1), Annex II and footnote (1), PDF pages 5, 16 and 18
rules.evidenceExcerpt: Nationals listed in Annex II are exempt for stays of no more than 90 days in any 180-day period. The exemption for Hong Kong SAR shall only apply to holders of a Hong Kong Special Administrative Region passport.

conditions: 任何连续 180 天内累计不超过 90 天。
豁免仅适用于澳门特别行政区护照。
不等同于保证入境，仍须满足外部边境入境条件。
rules.evidenceLocator: Regulation (EU) 2018/1806, Article 4(1), Annex II and footnote (2), PDF pages 5, 16 and 18
rules.evidenceExcerpt: Nationals listed in Annex II are exempt for stays of no more than 90 days in any 180-day period. The exemption for Macao SAR shall only apply to holders of a Região Administrativa Especial de Macau passport.

conditions: 仅适用于中华人民共和国签发的普通护照。
应在抵达前 3 天内提交 SG Arrival Card。
实际准许入境和停留期由 ICA 官员在口岸决定。
rules.evidenceLocator: Singapore Embassy in Beijing > Entry and visa requirements; Important notices
rules.evidenceExcerpt: With effect from 9 February 2024, holders of Ordinary Passports issued by the People's Republic of China will be exempted from visa requirements for a stay of up to 30 days in Singapore. Visitors are required to submit their SG Arrival Card within 3 days before arriving.

conditions: 仅适用于香港特区护照，不适用于香港特区签证身份书。
应在抵达前 3 天内提交 SG Arrival Card。
实际准许入境和停留期由 ICA 官员在口岸决定。
rules.evidenceLocator: Singapore Consulate-General in Hong Kong > Visa information; ICA entry requirements
rules.evidenceExcerpt: Hong Kong SAR and Macao SAR passports holders do not require a visa to enter Singapore for business or social visit purpose for up to 30 days. The visa requirement is necessary for HKSAR Document of Identity holders.

conditions: 仅适用于澳门特区护照，不适用于澳门特区旅行证。
应在抵达前 3 天内提交 SG Arrival Card。
实际准许入境和停留期由 ICA 官员在口岸决定。
rules.evidenceLocator: Singapore Consulate-General in Hong Kong > Visa information; ICA entry requirements
rules.evidenceExcerpt: Hong Kong SAR and Macao SAR passports holders do not require a visa to enter Singapore for business or social visit purpose for up to 30 days. ICA separately lists a Macao SAR Travel Permit as a visa-required document.

conditions: 香港特区签证身份书与香港特区护照是不同旅行证件，不能继承护照的 30 天免签。

rules.evidenceExcerpt: The visa requirement is necessary for HKSAR Document of Identity (DOI) holders as HKSAR passports and HKSAR DOIs are different sets of travel documents.

conditions: 澳门特区旅行证与澳门特区护照是不同旅行证件，不能继承护照的 30 天免签。
rules.evidenceLocator: Singapore Embassy in Beijing > Entry and visa requirements; ICA visa-required travel documents list
rules.evidenceExcerpt: Holders of all other travel documents issued by the PRC must continue to apply for an entry visa before travel into Singapore. These include ... Macau SAR Travel Permit.

conditions: 须持有效香港特区护照，从澳大利亚境外通过 Australian ETA App 申请。
ETA 通常 12 个月内可多次入境，每次最多停留 3 个月；护照更早到期时以护照有效期为限。
刑事定罪、健康要求等情况可能需要 Visitor visa 600。
rules.evidenceLocator: Subclass 601 > Overview, How long you can stay and Eligibility > Have an eligible passport
rules.evidenceExcerpt: You must hold a valid passport from one of these countries or jurisdictions ... Hong Kong (SAR of China). You can remain in Australia for 3 months after each entry.

conditions: 中国普通护照不在 ETA 601 合资格护照名单内。
应通过 Visa Finder 核对适用签证；Visitor visa 600 是官方列出的可能路线，具体 stream、期限与批准条件不能自动推断。
rules.evidenceLocator: Can I go to Australia? > visa requirement; Subclass 601 > Eligibility passport list and Step by step > Other ways to apply
rules.evidenceExcerpt: All other passport holders need the right visa to come to Australia. You also need to get your visa before you travel to Australia. The ETA-eligible passport list does not include China; other passport holders may be eligible for Visitor 600.

conditions: 澳门特区护照不在 ETA 601 合资格护照名单内。
